title: Craftable Copper Horse Armour Recipe
description: A datapack that adds the brand New Copper Horse Armour from The Copper Age UPDATE!!!!
body:
# **Craftable Copper Horse Armor:**

Saddle Up in Style Minecraft 1.21.9 introduced the Copper Age — a shiny new era of automation, traps, and decorative flair. Among the additions: Copper Horse Armor, a sleek new way to gear up your steed. But in vanilla? It’s loot-only. This datapack changes that, letting you craft it like any other armor piece and ride into the copper future.

**Note**:Copper Horse Armor Recipe is a custom recipe added by the datapack. If you are interested in more datapacks, check out the links at the end of the description. Feel free to include this in your modpacks, builds, or custom worlds — no permission needed.

**🧠 Why It’s Better**: Because copper deserves more than just blocks and buttons. Whether you're building a themed stable, roleplaying a steampunk rider, or just want your horse to match your base, this pack makes copper armor accessible and craftable — no loot table required.

**📦 How to Use**:

1. Download the .zip

2. Drop it into your world’s datapacks/ folder

3. Type /reload in-game

4. Start crafting your copper horse armor and ride with style
